question: In June 2025, West Bengal planned to make 800 km green wall along which of the following states, intercepting pollutants entering the State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **June 2025**, the state of **West Bengal** announced its plan to create an **800 km long green wall** along its border with **Jharkhand**.
 
• The green wall is intended to act as a **natural barrier** for intercepting **air pollutants** entering West Bengal from neighboring states.
 
• This initiative is part of West Bengal's efforts to combat **environmental pollution** and improve **air quality** in the region.
